content.short: Chainalysis provides intelligence and risk management tools to position users for long-term utility.
content.description: Since its founding in 2014, Chainalysis develops software and provides actionable intelligence to help traditional institutions embrace decentralized technology. The company works to foster trust between partners while implementing robust, low risk compliance standards. Through its work with investigators and regulators, Chainalysis has supported some of the blockchain industry's most high-profile prosecutions, underscoring its role in advancing secure, compliant crypto activity.
content.meta: Chainalysis offers software and information to help institutions integrate decentralized tech. Discover Chainalysis and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
